_doc: The one tannery common effluent treatment plant (CETP) in today's Vellore district, TALCO Pernambut, as listed by TNPCB (2020) and by the state's June 2026 progress report to NMCG, operating. No proposed CETP scheme for this district was found (the Department of Textiles' Nadanthai Vaazhi Cauvery schemes are in Erode and Namakkal districts, per the June 2026 report, p.3), so 'schemes' is empty.

Rows are transcribed from the PDFs and checked against the page's text layer (scripts/quotes.py) and read on the rendered page images (img/tnpcb-cetp-tannery-2020-p1-1.png, img/mpr-tn-2026-06-p55-55.png).

registerUnitId joins the plant to the TNGIS industry register's unit of the same name (treatment-plants.geojson, kind cetp, 1 unit). The join is by name and place and is the part to review: see joinBasis.

consentedKld repeats TNPCB's 2020 column headed 'CETP Consented Quantity (KLD)'; permittedKld its column 'Permitted quantity (in KLD)'; consentIssuedOn the column 'CTO issued on'; renewalValidTo the column 'RCO validity'. The June 2026 report gives the current renewal in mpr2026.renewalStatus. The engine (plant_facts) reads consentedKld, totalMembers, participatingMembers, permittedKld and mpr2026.
Left out: the list's other 12 tannery CETPs, printed in Tirupattoor, Ranipet, Erode, Dindigul, Tiruchirappalli and Chennai districts or with no district.
